convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <throwaway.pen> with FILE-REDIRECTED stdin (GC-001 finding 8); one execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>"], "png", "<dir>")' }) line per frame, then exit(). Default scale 2. The .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import (../../../design-system/in-progress/hemlock-library.lib.pen) and font URI (../../fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf) resolve. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs (all 15 sha256 identical). Environment cross-check: the 10 carried v001 frames export BYTE-IDENTICAL to the v001 capture's recorded exportSha256 values on this VM (linux x64) - pen rendering is platform-stable at the pinned version.
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention, GC-001/v001 precedent), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; the contract's pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 harness per-pixel setting, not this loop's budget); targets = NORMALIZED v002 prototype, contract root per state (section.gg; injected states use their own root), Chromium 151.0.7922.34 (playwright), viewport 900x600, deviceScaleFactor 2, reducedMotion reduce, fonts.ready + double-rAF + self-consistency gate (two captures byte-identical), fresh page per state; Heebo served to the browser via fontconfig from the same TTF the .pen references (Google Fonts links removed at normalization). Capture alignment: the root is sub-pixel-snapped to integer css coordinates (position:relative top/left compensation, harness-side only) so element pixels align with pen's integer-origin frame rasterization; for fractional-height frames the target's one trailing all-background row (past the element box) is cropped after asserting it is blank.
convergence.iterationNotes: Iteration 1 converged: 15/15 states 0.064-0.500% (budget 1.0%). The 10 carried states were taken verbatim from the v001 frames (the v4.13 engine is geometry-identical at height >= 220 per the contract) and VERIFIED against freshly rendered v002 targets, not assumed. The 5 new frames were generated with v001's node conventions (fade band as 1.5-degree stroked-arc steps with midpoint-sampled node opacity over the band token, half-disc clipped translucent start cap, ellipse tip cap, arc-tracking slider geometry); TINY text placement was calibrated by probe (pen ink offsets measured from a throwaway probe export at 17.6/600, 12/600, 12/400, 11/600) against target ink positions, with the cross-rasterizer estimator bias (-0.51 css px, consistent across sizes) calibrated out against v001's known-good placements. Residual diff is cross-rasterizer text antialiasing plus arc-edge AA, same class as v001.
convergence.geometryProbesDetail: Source-level: the 10 carried frames keep the v001 path data verbatim (unchanged in v4.13 at height >= 220 - re-verified against the rendered v002 page); the 5 new frames were generated from the engine's own math and verified against the rendered normalized page's DOM: value-zones-low-orange conic 'rgba(255,122,0,0.953) 0deg -> rgb 4deg -> 24deg', caps (256.08,230.00) clipped 0.953 / (240.66,182.54) opaque; value-zones-high-green = default's exact fade shape in the bright green; value-zones-min-track foreignObject display:none, track only (Z1); tiny-height-120 track 'M318.43 92.00 A48 48 0 1 1 401.57 92.00' sw 14, caps r 7 at (318.43,92.00)/(407.99,66.99), readout 17.6px baseline y 70, slider 230px margin-top 6px; tiny-height-floor-50 track 'M342.68 38.33 A20 20 0 1 1 377.32 38.33' sw 6, caps r 3 at (342.68,38.33)/(380.00,27.91), readout floored 12px baseline y 30.333 (all match design-rules V10). Pixel-space: per-state ink bounding box of export vs target within 2 css px on every edge (measured max delta 0.51 css px).

normalizationRecipe.identityNotes: Injections applied as an appended override <style> block (same selectors, later in cascade; the engine reads computed custom properties at draw time) - zero markup/layout/copy/behavior edits. The thumb's 2px #FFFFFF border (both themes, deliberate per prototype comment) is untouched - it binds $y:prim-base-white in the .pen (sanctioned universal constant). The thresholds preset's config hexes are untouched - the contract notes their light hexes ARE the file's own tokens; the band binds $sem-gaugeBandError whose light value equals it (identity at normalization). Dark-theme block untouched (themes: light).
normalizationRecipe.fontSwap: None needed at family level - the prototype already renders Heebo (design-rules 29). Re-pinned the SOURCE: Google Fonts request removed; Heebo served from the design-system variable TTF via fontconfig for both the browser targets and the pen exports.

tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Hemlock chart rules own the axis-label role with sem-text-meta; role-first binding collapses Bill's bespoke axis gray into the meta role (#5E5954). Deliberate divergence from the literal hue. (v001 call, carried.)
Near-black primary text on the control; the header/primary text role owns it. #171717 has no Hemlock step. (v001 call, carried.)
Secondary helper text at 11px; sem-text-subtle (#8A8680) fails the 4.5:1 small-text floor the a11y contract requires, sem-text-meta (6.4:1) passes. Contrast-driven role pick. (v001 call, carried.)
The slider-track role token exists (T3); role wins over the 3-unit hue delta (#D5D3D0). (v001 call, carried.)
Sanctioned universal-constant exception (token guide); a semantic pair would wrongly retheme an edge the prototype pins white in dark mode. (v001 call, carried.)
The band family gains an error member rather than painting a band with a text/border token; values alias the sem-text-error/sem-borders-error pair exactly.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: value-keyed band (valueZones), orange and green zones
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: #FF7A00 / #17C455 (--gauge-*-bright; v4.12b: one step brighter than the tone-band pair, band-only, readout stays ink - design-rules 12/16)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The v002 intent's own surface: the zones band needs its OWN pair so the tone bands and bracket thresholds keep the measured 3:1 base values - binding the base band tokens would erase the zones-band-brighter-than-tone-band relationship rule 12 requires the tokens to preserve. The blend mid-colours (straight RGB mixes from these endpoints) are banked as vectors Z2-Z5, not frames, so no blend token is needed.

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: max(12, 16k) = 12px at H=120 and H=50 (the floor engages - design-rules 19)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The floored value lands exactly on the xs step (12px); bound to the existing scale token rather than minting a k-floor token. The k-scaling idiom itself is the carried non-token gap.
Continues the v001 local gauge type-token family (text-size-gauge-value/label/endpoint); the H=50 readout floors at 12px and binds $y:text-size-xs.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: fade/ramp band translucency + graded-segments alphas + translucent caps
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: runtime rgba(color, alpha) conic stops and stroke alphas
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Every dim tone is node opacity over the token fill, never an alpha-baked color - a base-token swap re-themes the whole ramp; no frame carries a raw value. Conic gradients are expressed as 1.5-degree stroked-arc steps (sub-threshold vs the rendered conic); translucent clipped caps are exact half-disc paths. (v001 convention, carried to the new frames.)

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: hand-rolled arc gauge + native range slider
tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: (none - frames carry the prototype's exact path data with token paint)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: hemlock-library has GaugeChart and Slider components, but they are different designs that cannot reproduce the executable spec's geometry (240-degree fixed-canvas arc, fade-back-from-reading band, cap discipline, arc-derived slider width, TINY regime). Under the two-oracle split the .pen is the pixel oracle OF THIS prototype; composing the library components would fail every pixel compare. Divergence from Hemlock's existing GaugeChart/Slider is designer-visible, not silently resolved here. (v001 call, carried.)

The library's shadow color tokens are named prim-shadow-*-color (naming drift vs the design-system doc's unprefixed shadow-{size}-color - reported by v001, still unresolved); binding a prim-* is forbidden, so the v001 local themed shadow color pair is carried.
